# Kitchen Kiosk project instructions

Before answering a project-related request, planning work, or changing files:

1. Read [the project constitution](../.copilot/constitution.md).
2. Read [the application specification](../.copilot/app.spec.md).
3. Read [the android mobile prototype constitution](../.copilot/kiosk-mobile.constitution.md).
4. Read [the android mobile prototype specification](../.copilot/kiosk-mobile.spec.md).
4. Read [the android mobile development plan](../.copilot/kiosk-mobile.plan.md).
5. Consult the supporting documents listed there that are relevant to the task.

These are the shared project context, not a replacement for inspecting current code or following the user's current request. If they conflict with the code or the request, identify the discrepancy before making a behavior-changing decision. Do not claim access to conversations or decisions that are not recorded.

Preserve unrelated worktree changes. Keep implementation, directly related docs, decision records, and validation results consistent. Distinguish implemented, verified, proposed, and unverified behavior. Never put credentials or private user data in project documentation.

When new Markdown notes are added, follow the constitution's document-intake process; do not treat every new note as an approved requirement.
